paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 84:8.

notes.text: The supplied locator is Bereshit Rabbah 84:8. Rabbi Chiyya bar Zavda does not appear in the saved text of that section in the Midrash Rabbah — TE digital edition. The citation remains unconfirmed; this bounded nonmatch does not establish absence from other editions or a printing error.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume II, printed p. 444, also gives Bereshit Rabbah 84:8. The directly consulted Midrash Rabbah — TE text instead names Rabbi Chiyya bar Zavda in 85:8, where he warns about a wife’s sister and other female relatives in the discussion of Judah and Tamar. The English retains Hyman’s 84:8 rather than silently relocating it. This comparison does not establish whether Hyman used different numbering or whether his citation is erroneous. The earlier note describes the saved 84:8 passage; the newly read 85:8 supplies the named comparison.
